answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil swarms by requiring each new identity to post a non-refundable stake that is slashed when a cluster of accounts is shown to share control. Peers only pay agents whose stake and history trace back to distinct, independently funded nodes. A batch of fresh wallets fed by one source collapses into a single vertex in that graph and is penalized as one. To earn from fakes, an attacker must marshal real capital across a wide mesa of accounts, then eat slashing losses and lockups. A zephyr of empty throwaway accounts never clears the stake gate.
